# Awesome Canada

Northward's Services directory adapts the complete catalogue from
[Awesome Canada](https://awesome-canada.ca/) by
[wra-sol](https://github.com/wra-sol) and
[contributors](https://github.com/wra-sol/awesome-canada/graphs/contributors).

Source repository: <https://github.com/wra-sol/awesome-canada>.
Initial imported revision: `6ea942a7d3df9d4a0922015105b5263057fdb175`.
Catalogue: `data/resources.json`. Its names, descriptions, original categories,
levels, jurisdictions, URLs, tags, optional dates, and unknown fields are
retained. Northward adds stable IDs, conservative coverage labels, source
provenance and import/change history. No generated translations are included.

The upstream README states that `data/resources.json` is its source of truth
and links the MIT license. It does not prescribe a special attribution sentence.
The visible credit is: “Catalogue adapted from Awesome Canada by wra-sol and
contributors.” This credit supplements, rather than replaces, the notice below.

Linked destinations and datasets retain their own terms. Inclusion does not
imply government ownership, endorsement, current eligibility, or availability.
The complete unmodified upstream license is also preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE)
and published for visitors at `/data/services/LICENSE.txt`.
